name: flowchart
source:
flowchart TD
    A[Start] --> B{Decision?}
    B -- Yes --> C[Do it]
    B -- No --> D[(Store)]
    C --> E((End))
    D --> E
    subgraph Group
        C
        D
    end
    style A fill:#f9f,stroke:#333

source:

name: sequence
source:
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    participant A as Alice
    participant B as Bob
    A->>B: Hello Bob, how are you?
    activate B
    B-->>A: Great!
    deactivate B
    loop Every minute
        A->>B: Ping
    end
    alt success
        B->>A: OK
    else failure
        B->>A: Error
    end
    Note over A,B: A note
